in_marathi.name: Ahana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ahana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ahana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'aham', which means 'I'. It is often used as a female name in Hindu tradition, representing the radiant and shining nature of a woman. In Hindu mythology, Ahana is the name of the goddess of creation and is believed to be the embodiment of the cosmic power that brings new life into existence.
